capabilities: identify (Function ID - Kuna .fid + Ghidra FidService hashes)
description: Runs two independent open-source decompilers over one x86-64 ELF, identifies library functions by Function ID hashes and BSim similarity against a harvested corpus, and emits an evidence-graded record of where the engines agree and where they disagree.
name: SUNESIS — Two Engines, a Kuna + Ghidra decompiler witness
